source_gap_claims.behavior: The standard must define one primary responsibility, triggers, non-goals, I/O, dependencies, references, tests, evidence, and lifecycle boundaries.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require this complete set of standard sections.
source_gap_claims.subject: Required standard sections

source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator must reject a governed fixture missing any required declared section and report the applicable rule and relative location rather than relying on headings alone.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation covers missing required-section detection with rule and relative-location diagnostics.
source_gap_claims.subject: Required-section validation diagnostics

source_gap_claims.behavior: The versioned quality contract schema must accept valid contracts and reject malformed types or undeclared fields in its owned quality namespace.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations do not establish general quality-contract schema acceptance, type validation, or owned-namespace field rejection.
source_gap_claims.subject: Quality contract schema structure

source_gap_claims.behavior: The quality contract schema must reject unsupported quality-contract versions and unresolved references.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied version check concerns package contract versions, while local-only $ref rejection does not require rejection of all unresolved quality-contract references.
source_gap_claims.subject: Quality contract version and reference resolution

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation must require nonempty name and description, the canonical package name, and consistency between that package name and the declared Skill identity.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires these frontmatter identity and nonempty-field checks.
source_gap_claims.subject: Skill identity and frontmatter completeness

source_gap_claims.behavior: SKILL.md must contain fewer than 500 logical lines, with 499 passing and 500/501 failing; LF and CRLF count identically and a final newline adds no logical line.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligation set contains no SKILL.md logical-line limit or boundary-counting behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: SKILL.md logical-line limit

source_gap_claims.behavior: The standard must recommend a smaller main file without introducing a second hard line-count gate.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation covers this recommendation and single-gate constraint.
source_gap_claims.subject: Main-file size guidance
